sdlc-bugfix.description: AI-native SDLC bugfix flow: defect reports (ticket/alert/incident) taken in as intent → fix requirements (Spec) → plan → tasks → TDD execution → regression system testing → PR

sdlc-standard.description: AI-native SDLC standard flow: concept (intent) → requirements (Spec) → design (high-fidelity UE / architecture judgment / hld / detailed design / conflict resolution / finalization) → development (Plan → tasks → TDD execution → system testing → PR)
